scope: Diagnostic occlusion correlation, not a responsiveness or GPU-presentation acceptance test. Existing user previews remained running. No sampler or screenshots during the native trial; normal focus/window/update policy unchanged.

persistence.scope: Synchronous main-thread state preparation and atomic save, including existing-state validation, serialization, file/directory fsync. Acceptance and frame intervals include this cost when enabled. The fresh temp directory is retained for inspection; no user state is read or written.

trace_scope: Opt-in CPU schedule boundaries and the unchanged pipelined renderer extract callback. render_join_and_extract includes waiting for the render world, main-thread render tasks, extraction and dispatch; it is not GPU presentation timing. between_updates and before_render_extract are residuals including event-loop/OS/other-subapp work, not proven sleep time. Residual metadata is sampled at the end; other phase metadata at the start. between_updates belongs to the frame it precedes. window_occlusion_changed is a zero-duration notification observed in PreUpdate, not the OS event timestamp. occluded is the last primary-window notification, independent of focus; null means none has been observed for that window. Screenshot CPU spans are nested, not additive, and have no focus/occlusion/loading/action sample. All offsets share the proof start. Startup, current unfinished schedule and later shutdown are excluded. Boundary instrumentation adds overhead; window focus and update settings are unchanged.
surface_scope: CPU scheduling bracket before/after Bevy prepare_windows in the render schedule, including time to schedule either marker and concurrent render work. This is not exclusive function time or GPU time. It covers swapchain acquisition/reconfiguration for all extracted windows; a call may reuse an existing texture. Render invocation numbers are independent of main frame IDs. Correlate by shared-clock start/duration offsets. Markers add ordering constraints/overhead but leave prepare_windows and window settings unchanged.
conclusion: This trial did not reproduce the previous one-second surface-acquisition bracket. The largest handoff occurred with last observed occluded=false; fully hidden was observed later. These data do not establish occlusion as a cause or justify a hidden-window rendering workaround. Renderer/GPU responsiveness remains open.

provenance.tests: 6 passed; scope text subsequently clarified without changing behavior
